selection_rationale: Prioritize explicit project/workstream/lifecycle context paired with task, meeting, document, input, approval, deadline, follow-up, or status cues. Use the existing full-corpus 8k candidate pool first; broaden to the sorted 50k prefix where explicit project support is insufficient. Reserve 25% for realistic cue-bearing hard-negative candidates with no explicit project-context marker. Cues select candidates only and never assign labels.
exclusion_rules: Exclude all email IDs present in prior annotated or pilot data; extract IDs only.
Exclude records with empty subject, current_message under 100 or over 1600 characters, and quote-heavy current messages.
Select no more than one record per source_dataset/thread_id; reject exact and near-duplicate current_message bodies by normalized fingerprint and 64-bit 3-gram SimHash distance <= 3.
selection_order: The first tranche is ordered as 225 project-enriched candidates followed by 75 hard-negative candidates; remaining records are project-enriched then hard-negative. Within each stratum, source-pool priority is full-corpus 8k, then sorted prefix 50k, then stable SHA-256 rank.
